appraisal_events.evidence: j'ai justement eu, de moi-même, cette idée que vous aimeriez mieux rester ici ce soir. Et c'est précisément cela que j'étais allé demander au capitaine. — Et il a permis ? — Sans aucune difficulté.
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup is shown to have anticipated the narrator's wish on his own initiative and already secured the captain's permission for him to stay, without being asked.

status_effects.explanation: His unprompted, effective effort on the narrator's behalf casts him favorably as a thoughtful and capable friend.
